headline: Bangkok refinery blast injures nine, three critically
pages: An explosion and fire at an oil refinery in eastern Bangkok injured nine people on Thursday, three of them critically, according to AFP. The blast at the Phra Khanong facility, run by Bangchak Corporation, happened around 2:45 pm local time. The company said the fire was out within 30 minutes and the cause is under investigation. Black smoke covered the skyline, and officials told residents nearby to leave the area. Thailand's energy minister said the impact appeared limited because the fire started in a distillation tower about 100 meters from the oil storage. He noted the refinery sits in a residential area, and the government suspended production until operations can resume safely.
Bangchak said air quality near the site was normal. The plant can process up to 120,000 barrels a day. Source: BBC.
